tavily.text:
To install sqlparse, use the command `pip install sqlparse`. This will also provide the `sqlformat` command, which can be used for SQL formatting. For example, `sqlformat --reindent --keywords upper query.sql` will reindent and convert keywords to uppercase in `query.sql`. The sources do not provide information on additional installation methods beyond `pip install sqlparse`.
To install sqlparse, use the command `pip install sqlparse` as provided in the GitHub repository documentation. The latest release, version 0.5.5, was on December 19, 2025, and it includes bug fixes such as DoS protection and splitting of BEGIN TRANSACTION statements. The documentation also mentions that sqlparse is compatible with Python 3 and includes a pre-commit hook for formatting SQL files.
sqlparse tokenizes SQL text and groups the parts it recognizes into a tree of statements, clauses, identifiers and expressions. It accepts any input without validating it, and makes no assumptions about a particular SQL dialect, so vendor extensions and templated SQL parse too. It is a building block for formatters, linters, editors and query analysis tools.

Licensed under the New BSD license.
